concept: Honor in defeat or failure — how you lose says as much as how you win
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student experiences a simulated competitive loss (game, contest, debate) with a clear moment to blame someone else or take it honestly
exercise.branching_choice: Student chooses how to respond in the moment, then how to talk about it afterward
exercise.practice: Debrief on how the two responses would feel different a week later

assessment.success_marker: student distinguishes between the short-term relief of blame and the longer-term cost to trust/self-respect
